data.title: Sòphia High Tech Flight Hardware on Board VEGA-C VV30 as the European Launcher Carries Sentinel-3C and FLEX into Orbit
data.description: Sophia High Tech's flight hardware has been included in the VEGA-C VV30 as the European launcher carrier for Sentinel-3C and FLEX satellites. This launches important satellites into orbit.

data.title: Meet UROVO UPad: The Flagship Commercial Tablet for Connected Frontline Operations
data.description: A smart platform that combines payment, barcode scanning, RFID, and enterprise mobility was launched by UROVO in Singapore on September 15, 2026. The UPad, their primary commercial tablet, aims to streamline frontline operations. This device integrates payment services along with professional barcode scanning capabilities.

data.title: ENGWE Names Football Legend Robin van Persie as Brand Ambassador Ahead of Car-Free Day
data.description: In a collaboration titled "GOOD AS G.O.A.T," the partnership joins Van Persie's renowned career with ENGWE's commitment to accessible mobility - emphasizing their presence during crucial moments. On September 15, 2026, in Berlin, ENGWE, the global e-bike brand, revealed this initiative prior to Car-Free Day. This union highlights Dutch football legend Van Persie's lasting influence and ENGWE's dedication to everyday transportation solutions, aligning with the essence of the event to promote environmental consciousness and sustainable travel options.

data.title: Advance Relocation Systems Launches New Senior Move Management Website
data.description: Advance Relocation Systems (ARS) has introduced its new website on September 15, 2026, in Abingdon, Maryland. The website will cater to seniors, families, and relocation professionals, providing a centralized platform to access ARS's full range of senior services. This initiative aims to streamline the relocation process, emphasizing compassion and care at every stage. The new website is set to offer a user-friendly experience to explore various relocation options efficiently.

data.title: Undiluted launches to track the global venture debt and growth credit market
data.description: A newly launched specialist media and intelligence platform, Undiluted, is dedicated to covering lenders, deals, and trends in the global growth debt sector. Based in London, the platform focuses on venture debt and growth credit. The company officially launched on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Johnson Controls electrifies energy-intensive industries with new heat pumps that can triple energy efficiency and lower operating costs
data.description: A newly developed technology can provide up to three times the energy efficiency of electric boilers and greatly enhance efficiency when compared to natural gas boilers. This innovation allows customers to transition to electric high-temperature heat production without sacrificing performance. It can deliver output temperatures reaching up to 122°C to meet the demands of various applications.

data.title: Corgan Research Explores How Workplace Design Influences Attention and Focus
data.description: A renowned architecture and design company, Corgan, has recently published an award-winning study focusing on neurodiversity, ADHD, and the impact of workplace design on enhancing concentration and overall well-being. The research, recognized for its excellence, delves into strategies aimed at improving focus in the workspace.

data.title: Smartstream Further Enables Collateral Teams with Instant Answers and Controlled Automation through New MCP Servers
data.description: In London today, Smartstream introduced two new Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for Smart Collateral, designed to enhance collateral operations. These servers allow firms to link an MCP-compatible AI assistant to their collateral management platform, enabling conversational interactions for instant answers and controlled workflow automation. This innovative system maintains full governance over operations. This advancement aims to streamline processes and optimize efficiency for financial institutions and enterprises worldwide.

data.title: FICO European Fraud Map: UK Resilient as Other European Countries See Losses Climb by up to 21%
data.description: In London, the 2025 European Fraud Map by FICO reveals positive advancements by the UK financial services sector in combatting fraud. Card fraud losses in the UK increased by a modest 2% year-on-year, contrasting sharply with countries like Norway, Sweden, Poland, Hungary, and Greece where fraud losses surged by 15% or more annually. Overall in Europe, card fraud losses have hit a record €1.69 billion, highlighting the varying trends in fraud prevention across different countries.

data.title: More Than Half of Global Businesses Want Greater Control Over Their Data in Latest Digital Sovereignty Push, According to Expereo
data.description: Businesses globally are increasingly prioritizing data control amidst rising concerns regarding AI, security, and compliance. According to a recent IDC InfoBrief commissioned by Expereo*, over half (53%) of enterprises express a desire for increased control over their sensitive and strategic data. Additionally, a significant 33% of organizations worldwide now consider digital sovereignty a top or high priority. The research also reveals that 30% of companies are actively seeking ways to enhance their data control measures.

data.title: Perspectum Appoints Warren Cresswell as Chief Executive Officer
data.description: Perspectum, a precision health company based in Oxford, England, has named Warren Cresswell as its new Chief Executive Officer starting from September 15, 2026. With over 25 years of experience in diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and laboratory services, Mr. Cresswell is a seasoned global life sciences executive. This move aims to further enhance the company's non-invasive solutions for accelerating drug development and enhancing patient outcomes in cardiometabolic disease.

data.title: payabl. Renews BEONIX Festival Payments Partnership for Second Year, Extending Support Across ETKO
data.description: In Limassol, Cyprus, European fintech provider payabl. has extended its partnership with Kaspinas Group, the organizer of BEONIX Festival and various events at ETKO. Through this collaboration, payabl. remains the Official Payments Partner for BEONIX and offers payment solutions for events at ETKO. The upcoming BEONIX 2026 event scheduled for September 25–27 will feature 68  participants.

data.title: Northern Trust Survey: Asset Managers Sharpen Focus on Core Capabilities to Drive Growth
data.description: In Chicago, a recent report by Northern Trust titled "Driving Growth in Asset Management 2026" reveals findings from a survey of 300 executives from asset management companies worldwide. The report sheds light on strategies for growth in the industry over the next five years.

data.title: Edgecore Networks to Showcase Full-Stack Solutions at Network X 2026
data.description: Located in HSINCHU, Taiwan, Edgecore Networks, a subsidiary of Accton Technology Corporation, is set to exhibit their comprehensive network solutions at Network X 2026 in Vienna, Austria from October 13 to 15. The event will be held at Messe Wien, where Edgecore will present their managed network services offerings. Visitors can visit Booth H74 to learn about Edgecore's integrated solutions, which include Wi-Fi access points, switches, gateways, cloud management, and IoT technologies. Edgecore is renowned for providing network solutions to enterprises, data centers, and telecommunication service providers.

data.title: PHX Energy Services Corp. ANNOUNCES Quarterly DIVIDEND
data.description: Calgary-based PHX Energy Services Corp. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per common share, classified as an “eligible dividend” under Canada's Income Tax Act. The dividend will be payable on October 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 30, 2026.
